summary: Tested public API endpoints and core desktop/mobile UI flows. Homepage, catalogue, live match, live Baker Chat, and mobile layout loaded successfully.

minor.issue: Returned product Cinnamon Rolls while the live AI explanation recommended Chocolate Chip Banana Loaf; response product and explanation can disagree.

integration_issues.issue: Browser assertion did not observe the expected cart count after Add to my box; this needs verification because the test stopped before box/chat assertions.

action_items: Ensure /api/match explanation references the exact product returned in product.
Verify cart count/state updates after adding a recommendation and ensure adding the box does not unexpectedly overwrite existing cart items.
critical_code_review_comments: The frontend catches match/chat API failures and silently substitutes fallback content, which can hide live integration outages from users.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public API and responsive homepage tested. Recheck cart state, then complete WhatsApp popup and chat assertions.
rca of the issue: The match endpoint selects a deterministic catalogue product but independently asks the LLM for prose, so the model can name a different catalogue product. The cart test stopped at the first count assertion and requires follow-up against rendered text/state.
